observations.daily_time_definition: Unconfirmed: UTC daily default; 06UTC end-labelled and +/-1-day sensitivity exported.
observations.official_idf: Preserved exactly. Matched-period LP3 refit is separate. Asterisk-flagged 2010 annual maxima retained raw and withheld from refits; flag definition not supplied.

geography.assignment: one representative point per footprint; ambiguous neighbourhood areas withheld

terrain.method: weighted flatness and relative low position (negative TPI), fixed parameters
terrain.limitations: DSM includes vegetation/buildings. No flow routing, sewer capacity, infiltration, hydraulic depth or damage calibration.

hazard.method: Duration- and return-period-specific MGM multiplicative anchoring; change factors preserved for each model and cell.
hazard.spatial_assumption: Single-station bias factor transferred uniformly across district; unvalidated in uplands.
hazard.temporal_assumption: MGM rolling-duration maxima vs CORDEX fixed 3h/24h blocks; difference not independently corrected.
hazard.tail: 200/500y levels are extrapolations from about 30y baseline; supplied LP3 table is a separate 56y reference.
hazard.daily_validation_scope: Daily ERA5 validation does not validate CORDEX projections or subdaily rainfall.
